title: Inadequate Consent
description: The homeowner may not fully understand what data is being collected and how it will be used, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Home Hub may improperly handle or store the homeowner's personal data, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Home Hub may retain personal data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse.

title: Linkability Threat
description: The guest user may be linked to their actions or identity through the temporary access code they enter, which could be observed or intercepted by unauthorized parties.

title: Data Retention Threat
description: The Home Hub may retain logs or records of the access codes entered by guest users, which could be accessed by unauthorized individuals, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The temporary access code entered by the guest user could be intercepted during transmission to the Home Hub, allowing unauthorized parties to gain access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Sensor Data
description: The Home Hub (P1) may inadvertently expose sensitive motion/door/sensor event data to unauthorized users or processes due to improper access controls.

title: Inadequate Data Integrity Checks
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may not implement sufficient integrity checks, allowing for unauthorized modifications of the logged events, which could mislead users or systems relying on this data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may retain motion/door/sensor event data longer than necessary, leading to potential privacy violations if the data is accessed or leaked after its intended use.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Home Hub may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to upload or access recorded camera clips.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The Cloud Video Storage may be vulnerable to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to recorded camera clips.

title: Insecure Data Transmission
description: The data being transmitted from the Home Hub to the Cloud Video Storage may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to potential identification of users or their activities.

title: Excessive Exposure of Personal Data
description: The Home Hub forwards a real-time motion alert which may contain personal data, potentially exposing it to external parties known and anticipated at design time, or inadvertently broadcasting it, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Inadequate Authentication
description: The mobile app backend may not have strong authentication mechanisms, allowing unauthorized users to receive notifications meant for the homeowner.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The homeowner's device may store notifications insecurely, making them accessible to unauthorized applications or users.

title: Data Misuse
description: The homeowner may inadvertently share the motion-detected notifications with others, leading to privacy breaches.

title: Data Leakage
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently share more detailed analytics than intended, leading to potential exposure of sensitive user information.

title: Inadequate Data Handling
description: The cloud analytics vendor may not handle the aggregated analytics properly, leading to potential identification of individual users through the aggregated data.

title: Data Misuse
description: The cloud analytics vendor could misuse the aggregated analytics for purposes not agreed upon, such as selling the data to third parties.

title: Unintended User Profiling
description: The cloud analytics vendor may create user profiles based on the aggregated data, which could lead to privacy violations if users are identified.

title: Violation of storage limitation principle
description: Personal data is stored longer than needed when the mobile app backend retrieves the video clip for playback, potentially leading to non-compliance with data protection regulations.
